Description:
  StatePocket durable local state for agents and tools.

Usage:
  statepocket [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information
  --version       Show version information

Commands:
  mcp                  Run the StatePocket MCP server over stdio.
  resource <resource>  Inspect one embedded documentation resource by URI or resource id.
  schema <tool>        Print the static MCP schema for a tool.

  statepocket mcp [options]

Options:
  --db-path <db-path>              Path to the SQLite database file.
  --enable-tools <enable-tools>    Comma-separated allowlist of tool names.
  --disable-tools <disable-tools>  Comma-separated denylist of tool names.
